q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a call centre per seat?
title: Call centre emissions per seat
short: Add the centre's electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and generator diesel at 2.68 kg per litre, then divide by production seats. Night shifts and 24-hour cooling raise use per seat, and employee cabs are a separate Scope 1 or Scope 3 line.

ul: Electricity for desks, IT, air conditioning and lights.
Refrigerant top-ups for the AC plant.

p: Cabs the company runs are Scope 1; cabs from a vendor with drivers are Scope 3. Night-shift transport is often a large share of a BPO footprint.
Divide by production seats, and by seat-hours for sites running different shift patterns.

example.title: Worked example: 400-seat centre (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 33,558 / 400 = 83.9 kg CO2 per seat a month
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your bills and seat count.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
